experiences.description:
Shopify Strategy & Revenue Growth

I partner with e-commerce brands at the intersection of strategy and execution - helping them unlock the full revenue potential of the Shopify ecosystem. Conversion rate, AOV, revenue per session, customer retention - these aren't just metrics, they're the scoreboard, and I build the playbook around them.

Every engagement starts with a clear-eyed look at where the biggest opportunities live, then moves fast to capitalize on them. Data-driven decisions, sharp UX thinking, and a relentless focus on what actually moves the needle.

Brands that are ready to operate at a higher level deserve a partner who's equally invested in the outcome. If you want to build something better - let's talk.

Founded in December 2009, Vanilla has reinvented the online forum. 

Since 2010, Vanilla's software-as-a-service (cloud) offering has allowed us to offer more advanced functionality and a more robust solution that meets the needs of communities of all sizes. 

Vanilla helps thousands of organizations provide a great community experience to millions of people worldwide.

experiences.position: Senior, Director of Sales, Shopify Plus
experiences.description:
Architected and implemented an enterprise business unit targeted at mid-market and Fortune 500 organizations: 

+ Generated $800K+ of ARR in 6-months 
+ Managed all sales activities through a strategic funnel focusing on C-Level economic buyers 
+ Scoped and project managed all implementations: average PS engagement was $50-100K
+ Managed 3-Account Executives: identified proper opportunities and coached the AEs through a strategic sales funnel increasing ARPU while shortening the sales cycle by 32%

Designed and implemented a SaaS revenue model for 6-Account Executives with individual annual quotas of $1M+ ARR:

+ Generated ARR of $6.5M+ 
+ Defined and implemented all sales messaging and funnel stages  
+ Developed a churn management model that generated $500K+ of MRR
+ 100%+ of revenue, unit and activitiy targets for 15 of 16 Quarters

Developed and implemented a channel strategy to drive revenue from strategic partnerships:

+ Established partnerships with IP companies to resell Shopify and generate leads 
+ Fostered relationships with payment gateways in Europe and Asia expanding market share
+ Brokered revenue share agreements yielding upwards of $200K+ of ARR  
+ Sourced partners that expanded the The Shopify App Store – agreements generated reciprocal revenue for both the app developer and Shopify
